title: MCU Base Access Requirements
description:
### 📌 Marine Corps Base Quantico - Base Access Requirements (MCU - EAST NODE - Attendees)

All participants must ensure their ability to access **MCB Quantico** from **9/15 to 9/18**. 

For complete base access guidance, visit the [MCB Quantico Base Access Portal](https://www.quantico.marines.mil/Info/Base-Access/).

---

### 📝 Civilian Visitor Instructions

Civilian visitors who **do not** have a Common Access Card (CAC) must complete the following steps:

| Step | Action Required |
|---|---|
| **1** | Register in **DBIDS**. |
| **2** | Print the **NAVMC 5512** form. |
| **3** | Bring the printed **NAVMC 5512** form and **two forms of valid ID** to the MCB Quantico Visitor Control Center. |
| **4** | Obtain a pass at the **Visitor Control Center**. |

> 💡 **Tip:** It is recommended to arrive early to pick up your base access pass at the Visitor Control Center. Additional details can be found on the [Civilian Visitor Access Page](https://www.quantico.marines.mil/Info/Base-Access/Civilian-Non-Military/).

---

### 📍 Key Locations & Addresses

| Location | Facility / Building | Street Address | City, State, Zip | Notes & Links |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Visitor Control Center** | MCB Quantico VCC | 27190 Russell Road | Stafford, VA 22554 | [VCC Info](https://www.quantico.marines.mil/Info/Base-Access/Visitor-Control-Center/) |
| **Event Location** | Warner Building (Warner Center for Advanced Military Studies) | 2044 Broadway Street | Quantico, VA 22134 | Hackathon venue location |
| **MCU Library** | Alfred M. Gray Research Center | 2040 Broadway Street | Quantico, VA 22134 | Parking garage nearby |

title: Accredited AI on AWS for DoW - Tier 1 Sponsor Showcase
description:
This session will give an overview of accredited AI on AWS for the Department of War. We will cover the strategic picture of where AI fits for the Marine Corps, and why services like Kiro, Bedrock, and Quick at IL4/IL5 help achieve outcomes, not demos. We will finish by examining how to mature hackathons at scale by matching mission need, capability, and enablement.

title: NPS Welcome Aboard

description: Participants will formalize their teams and begin use case selection during this time period.

description: Day 1 Hacking Window.  Teams will be let loose to tackle their use cases during this time period.  Lunch period and breaks will be at the direction of each team.

description: Final-day operations - complete the solution, harden the MVP, and rehearse the demo to ensure Shark Tank-ready execution tomorrow.

title: Finalize and Submit
description: Finalize your presentation and submit for the semi-final round.

title: NPS - Active Hacking Window Day 2
description: Day 2 Hacking Window. Teams will continue to tackle their use cases during this time period. Lunch period and breaks will be at the direction of each team.

title: Refreshments and Networking
description: Refreshments will be available in the Warner Lounge on the 2nd floor.

title: Team Presentations (semi-final round)
description: Semi-final round team presentations

title: NPS - Shark Tank Presentation Preparation
description: Teams will shift from active hacking to Shark Tank style presentation preparation during this time period.

title: NPS - Day 2 Closeout Synch
description: NPS Teams will brief their end of day status at this time. Any RFS for additional resources/mentorship will be registered at this time.

title: Light Breakfast and Networking
description: Light Breakfast and Networking session before the final round.

title: Hackathon Outbrief and Staging for Judges
description: Debrief the last 3 days of hacking and align judges on the day's flow with Shark Tank-style team pitches and demos, a review of judge criteria, and how the hackathon scoring will be applied consistently across all teams.

title: NPS - Final Touches
description: NPS teams will use this time to put final touches on their solutions and presentations for follow on judging.

title: NPS - Hackathon Outbrief, Team Presentations and Judging
description: Judging Panel will convene, outbrief on the hackathon events will occur, judging criteria transparently reviewed, and then teams will present their Shark Tank briefs for the judges.

title: NPS - Hackathon Awards Presentation & Closing Remarks
description: Hackathon Winner will be declared by judges.  Following judge departure - Maj Fusco and key leaders will provide closing remarks for the hackathon aboard NPS.
